summary: Char-code-obfuscated hardcoded author URL injected as sourceUrl in outbound WhatsApp rich messages
details: In lib/Socket/messages-send.js, the AIRich builder overrides the sourceUrl / click-through attribution of image and video items in outbound WhatsApp interactive/reels messages with a hardcoded URL reconstructed via String.fromCharCode(...) that decodes to https://fiora.nixel.my.id/. The caller-supplied URL is not used for sourceUrl on those items. The destination is obfuscated to hide it from casual reading of the source. No installer secrets are read, no code is fetched or executed, and no credentials are exfiltrated; the covert action is redirection of the recipient's click traffic through the author's site while using the installer's WhatsApp bot identity to send the message.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
